purpose: Core binary: serve and probe commands; connects Mongo (MONGO_USER + SetAuth or URI credentials)/NATS (publisher and reconciler get separate JetStream clients) and two Redis instances (state: slot pool; dedupe: cid + event ack marks) with credential and password redaction; wires components (event reconciler only when RECONCILE_ENABLED); ordered startup and budgeted shutdown (reconciler stops after gRPC, before router; cid batcher starts before the router and drains right after it, before the flusher); small warm Redis pools (dedupe: 2x CID_BATCH_SHARDS + 4 conns, MinIdleConns, no command retries, 1 dial retry; both clients DisableIdentity); gRPC served only after a clean start; metrics_wiring.go registers detectors on the admin /metrics (worker lag/processed/failures and per-effect republished/dropped on every core; reader metrics only with RECONCILE_ENABLED); prepare ensures the work stream after the event stream; effect workers on every core (effects_wiring.go: registry MessageInserted -> room_activity, msg_created; RoomInserted -> room_created; EditInserted -> room_activity, edit_projection, msg_changed; ReactionChanged -> room_activity, reaction_counter, reaction_event; PinInserted -> room_activity, pin_projection, pin_event (reaction_pin_effects_wiring.go builds the four new effects with their own counter and pin projector); MemberChanged -> room_activity; ReadChanged, MessageHidden, HistoryCleared and MemberCountCheck registered with no effect yet, so their records are acked; work queues nak unknown kinds after WORK_RETRY_DELAY) on a third JetStream client; start after the slot manager, before the reader; stop after the reader, before the router (WORK_DRAIN + 1s); resync subcommand (resync_command.go: Mongo + NATS only, reuses client helpers and redaction); service_wiring.go builds the mutate.Mutator (own access checker with access.DefaultPolicy{LockedKinds: MESSAGE_LOCKED_KINDS} plus the reaction store, a counter.Toucher over messages and reactions, the pin facts and a pinproj.Projector) and the CoreService; effect metrics skip reconcile_republished_total for effects that never publish (edit_projection, pin_projection); wireService takes a serviceDeps struct (store, router, publisher, cid batcher, timer JetStream client, config, redacting logger): the mutator gets MESSAGE_LOCKED_KINDS and cfg.Limits (REACTION_EMOJIS, PIN_LIMIT, member batch), dedupe.Requests on the cid batcher with CID_COMMITTED_TTL, the router as member forgetter and work.Timers on the work stream (publisher JetStream client, WORK_STREAM, WORK_SUBJECT_ROOT, WORK_PARTITIONS, member count check delay 5s until MEMBER_COUNT_CHECK_DELAY); purpose: Permission hook: Policy (one Check method) and Checker, which always enforces tenant and membership before the policy; Checker.Admit checks tenant and membership without the policy; Checker.Allow asks the policy; Authorize does both; Request.Author and Request.Kind are the author and kind of the target message (Kind 0 for room actions); DefaultPolicy (default of NewChecker and the actor) lets only the author edit or delete and allows every other action (D86); DefaultPolicy.LockedKinds denies edit/delete of those kinds even to the author (D87); react_message, pin_message and unpin_message are allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy, also on locked kinds (D94); member and read actions add_members, remove_member, leave_room, change_member_role, set_member_priority and mark_read (MarkUnread uses mark_read); Request.Target is the target member (callers pass a stand-in with role member when the target has no doc or left) and Request.Role the wanted role; DefaultPolicy lets owner or admin add members, the owner remove anyone and an admin remove only a target with role member, only the owner change roles or set priority, anyone leave or mark read (D101); AllowMembers allows every member; used by SendMessage in the actor; GetHistory/GetEditHistory in grpcsrv and the change commands in mutate

Per-room actors behind a Router: one write group in flight; seq assignment; cid admission (pkg/lru cache then Redis); reconcile Duplicate/Unknown via Find; per-entry reservation budget; answer the ack and enqueue events (best-effort) before handing the cid Commit to the registry; retire on slot move; asks the access policy before admitting a send; caches members per actor for memberCacheTTL 10s and drops the cache when Router.ForgetMembers bumps its generation (read before the store read); never caches not-a-member (D106); backs off with jitter (5ms to 200ms) between seq reassign rounds on contention and yields the room through retire when rounds run out; counts yields and cid elsewhere

Loads every core env var with defaults; aggregates parse errors; cross-field timeout rules and shutdown StopPlan (includes the reconciler step RECONCILE_DRAIN + 1s and the cid batcher drain 2 x REDIS_OP_TIMEOUT); CID_BATCH_SHARDS/CID_BATCH_MAX_KEYS/CID_BATCH_QUEUE; RECONCILE_DELAY (EffectDelay, always checked) < EVT_STREAM_DUPLICATES; RECONCILE_ROOM_CACHE -> EffectRoomCache; WORK_DUPLICATES > RECONCILE_CONFIRM_EVERY + RECONCILE_DRAIN; reuses component Validate(); MONGO_USER/MONGO_PASSWORD/MONGO_AUTH_SOURCE (rejects MONGO_USER next to URI credentials) and REDIS_*/REDIS_DEDUPE_* addr/db/password, all passwords with *_PASSWORD_FILE (file wins); credential redaction for URLs/errors/text and Secrets()/RedactSecrets for passwords; WORK_* work stream (replicas from EVT_STREAM_REPLICAS, AckWait = RECONCILE_DELAY + 30s; names must differ from the event stream); Effects (WORK_FETCH_BATCH/WORK_FETCH_WAIT/WORK_RETRY_DELAY/WORK_DRAIN, partitions from WORK_PARTITIONS, poll = SLOT_TICK); StopPlan.Workers; default budget 28s; MESSAGE_LOCKED_KINDS (comma list of kind names, trimmed, empty items ignored; unknown name is a boot error) -> LockedMessageKinds (D87); REACTION_EMOJIS (comma list via list/listOr, trimmed, empty = mutate.DefaultEmojis) and PIN_LIMIT -> Limits (mutate.Limits, checked by Limits.Validate: 1..100 distinct valid emojis, 1..1000 pins; errors name REACTION_EMOJIS and the bad item; D95); REACTION_COUNT_DELAY -> ReactionCountDelay (default effects.DefaultCountDelay 1s, positive and at most RECONCILE_DELAY so effect delays grow along the registry)

Redis cid dedupe store on the dedupe Redis instance (chatim-redis-dedupe): key chatim:cid:{room}:{user}:{cid}, or chatim:req:{room}:{user}:{request_id} for Key.Space SpaceRequest; batched Lua Reserve (pending p:{core}) / Commit (c:{seq}:{ms}; old 4-field values read as absent) / conditional Abort; degraded mode via redisguard; Batcher batches Reserve/Commit/Abort across rooms per shard (slot % CID_BATCH_SHARDS): Reserve rounds sent as soon as none is in flight (up to MaxKeys), Commit/Abort queued without blocking and flushed on Close; Requests dedupes commands by request_id over any Registry (the Batcher in prod): Begin maps Reserve to RequestNew/RequestDone/RequestBusy (Redis errors fall back to a RAM LRU of RequestCacheSize entries valid until ttl after the command), Finish = Commit + remember, Cancel = Abort

Effect engine workers: one goroutine per work partition that fetches only while this core owns the slot with the same number (checked before every fetch); groups a batch by change kind and runs the kind's effects in registry order, each after max(CommittedAt) + its delay; acks a record when every effect returned nil, else naks it after WORK_RETRY_DELAY; Close stops fetching, lets a running effect finish and hands records still waiting their delay back with Nak(0); undecodable and deferred unknown-kind records count as failures; Stats (processed, failed, lag behind commit + delay); msg_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY): batch ack mark lookup (failure = all unmarked), majority Find of unmarked messages per room, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for every PubAck; missing doc, unknown room or invalid key is dropped and counted; room type cache shared across partitions; room_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Rooms.Get, event rebuilt with pbconv.RoomCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; unknown room dropped and counted; room_activity uses seq 0 for every kind except MessageInserted (edits, reactions and pins bump only the change time and bucket, kept apart from new messages of the same timeline); edit_projection effect (delay 0) for EditInserted (a ver 0 original row returns nil at once): Edits.At, Messages.ApplyEdit (CAS by version), PurgeText below a delete fact; missing fact dropped and counted; msg_changed effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark; skips a ver 0 record without reading): Edits.At, room type cache, Find, refuses (retry) while the projection is behind the fact, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageChanged (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; counts as republished only PubAcks the stream had not deduplicated; missing fact, message or room dropped; reaction_counter effect (delay REACTION_COUNT_DELAY) for ReactionChanged: groups the batch by message, witnesses = newest change number per user, Find + counter Touch (CAS on rx.v), counts a bump as Repaired (CT1), publishes counts_changed of the current version (nothing at version 0), counts only PubAcks the stream had not stored; a stale witness, contention or store error retries every record of the message; reaction_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Reactions.Get, publishes reaction_changed only when the doc change number equals the record (newer doc skips, older doc = ErrStaleRead retry), missing doc or room dropped; pin_projection effect (delay 0) for PinInserted: one pinproj Project per room up to the newest pin version of the batch, missing room dropped, other errors retry every record of the room; pin_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Pins.At(room, pv), Find, pbconv.PinChanged (deleted message without text); missing fact, message or room dropped; eventPublisher shares the publish loop, room type cache and counters of the new event effects; groupRecords groups record indexes by key

Room/Member/Message types and validation; message kind names from one table (ParseKind: text; unknown -> ErrInvalidArgument); Message edit state (Version/Deleted/EditedAt) and view-only Hidden; Edit row (EditText/EditDelete, EditOriginal only at version 0 = the content at send time; one text per row, no Prev); Member.ClearedAt (zero = never cleared, D97); HiddenMessage (user, room, thread, seq, hide time); Message.Reactions summary (counts per emoji + version; Message is no longer comparable with ==); Reaction doc (one emoji per user and message, empty emoji = tombstone, Prev, change number N), ValidateEmoji (UTF-8, 1-32 bytes, no control runes), SortReactionCounts (count desc, emoji asc); PinAction fact (PinOpPin/PinOpUnpin stored as 1/2), Pin, PinState.Pinned, FoldPins (pure: facts above the version in pv order, newest pin first, no-op facts only move the version); ErrTooManyPins (failed precondition); ErrEmojiNotAllowed (invalid argument, D95); member set doc (D98): MemberState (MemberActive 1, MemberRemoved 2; tombstones kept), RoleAdmin, Member.Ver/Priority/Previous*/RequestID/UpdatedAt/UpdatedBy/LastChangeAt/ReadSeq/ReadVer (Member stays comparable with ==), Member.Next (pure membership step: Ver+1, Previous* = old, keeps JoinedAt/ClearedAt/ReadSeq/ReadVer), Join.Apply (pure add/re-add: active unchanged, else active role member, priority 0, ReadSeq max, ReadVer+1, keeps ClearedAt, D99), AddedBy, ParseRole, CreationRequestID ({room}-created), NewRoom members active at Ver 1; MemberCount, Room.MemberCountVer, ReadPosition (D105); MaxMemberBatch 1000 (D107); ErrDirectRoom/ErrLastOwner (failed precondition), ErrMemberNotFound (not found), ErrTooManyMembers (invalid argument) (D101); tenant/user/cid charset; text <= 16KB UTF-8; thread must be 0 in M2a; page limit; domain errors wrapping apperr kinds

Event ack marks on the dedupe Redis: bitmap chatim:evtack:{room}:{thread}:{seq>>13}, one bit per message; pipelined SETBIT per key plus PEXPIRE (EVT_ACK_MARK_TTL, 1h) only for chunks not refreshed within TTL/4 (refreshLog in RAM, cleared at 65536 chunks; a failed pipeline records nothing) and GETBIT lookups; degraded mode via redisguard (a lost mark only costs a republish)
Sharded batching flusher: groups from many rooms into one insertMany per Window/MaxBatch; one insert in flight per shard; per-group Deadline (not sent -> ErrNotSent); results split per group

CoreService handlers CreateRoom/SendMessage/GetHistory/EditMessage/DeleteMessage/HideMessage/ClearHistory/GetEditHistory/ReactMessage/PinMessage/UnpinMessage/GetReactionSettings; caller identity from x-chatim-tenant/x-chatim-user metadata; CreateRoom retries id collisions and enqueues room_created on the publisher (fast path; a refused enqueue is not retried here); GetHistory reads the store directly with tenant and membership checks; change RPCs are thin calls into mutate.Mutator (callerAndRoom parses caller and room id); GetEditHistory checks the key and limit (PageLimit); admits (access ReadEditHistory), finds the message (missing = NotFound), asks the policy with the message author, deleted = no versions; Edits.History after after_ver, an empty page = no versions, on the first page (after_ver 0) the ver 0 original row (Edits.At) goes first when present, mapped by pbconv.MessageVersions; Deps requires Mutator/Edits/Hidden; PageReader has Page and Find; GetHistory builds the view.Viewer from the member's cleared_at and one Hidden.HiddenIn over the page's seq range (skipped for an empty page or when its newest message is cleared); ClearHistory returns cleared_at; ReactMessage returns the change number and the reaction counts (pbconv.ReactionSummary), PinMessage/UnpinMessage return the pin version and the current pins (pbconv.Pins); all three are thin calls into mutate (react_pin.go); GetHistory returns Message.reactions (counts per emoji only, own emoji is M3) except on deleted or hidden placeholders; GetReactionSettings (reaction_settings.go, not room-routed) requires the caller metadata and returns mutate.Mutator.ReactionEmojis (REACTION_EMOJIS, D95)

Pull-based Prometheus registry: Source list (counter or gauge read by function, optional labels) served by Handler as /metrics with chatim_core_ prefix and Go/process collectors; rejects conflicting sources

Change commands outside the actor (D82): Edit/Delete admit through access.Checker (tenant and membership), read the message, ask access.Policy with the message author and kind (default: author only; no author or owner rule in mutate, D86), read the last edit fact, recognize a retry (fact at base+1 with the same by/kind/text, also on a duplicate version from Append), refuse a deleted message and a stale base, on the first edit (not a delete) insert the ver 0 original row (sender, send time, sent text; ErrEditExists = already there) right before the fact, insert the fact (version base+1), project onto messages (CAS by version), purge the text of rows 0..ver-1 on delete, re-read the snapshot and enqueue msg_edited/msg_deleted best effort before answering; Hide (admit, message must exist, ask the policy with the author; upsert into hidden at the server time) and ClearHistory (server time cut to ms, $max cleared_at on the member, returns the mark as time.Time, D97) are per-reader values with no fact and no event; React (D89, D90, D95): validates the key and the emoji (ValidateEmoji, empty = remove; a non-empty emoji outside Limits.Emojis is ErrEmojiNotAllowed before any read), admits and asks the policy (react_message), refuses a new emoji on a deleted message (no per-message emoji count limit), Reactions.Set/Remove (no write and no event when already in the wanted state), enqueues reaction_changed, touches the counts inline (counter, FastTouchTries CAS tries, the caller's write as witness; failures ignored, the worker converges) and enqueues counts_changed when the summary moved; Limits (Emojis: REACTION_EMOJIS, nil = DefaultEmojis, 1..MaxEmojiList distinct valid emojis, cloned; PIN_LIMIT 1..1000, zero = default) checked by New; ReactionEmojis returns a copy of the list; Pin/Unpin (D92): admit and ask the policy (pin_message/unpin_message), refuse to pin a deleted message (unpin still works, delete leaves pins alone), up to 3 tries of: pinproj Current, already in the wanted state = success without fact or event, PinLimit exact, append the fact at pv = current + 1 (key is the CAS); a duplicate pv with the same op/thread/seq/by is this command's result, another fact retries; out of tries = ErrRetryLater; then Project (CAS pv, falls back to FoldPins and leaves the projection to the worker) and enqueue msg_pinned/msg_unpinned best effort; member commands (D98-D102, D111): AddMembers (request_id as ValidCID, users ValidUser, deduped in order, 1..Limits.MemberBatch else ErrTooManyMembers; admit, DM = ErrDirectRoom, ask the policy; dedupe.Requests Begin: Busy = ErrRetryLater, Done = MembersOf filtered by AddedBy with no write or event, New = arm the member count timer (failure cancels the request, ErrRetryLater), read the last seq once, one AddMembers write, failure cancels the request; then ForgetMembers when docs changed, AddMemberCount(Changed) then Disarm (Changed 0 only Disarm; a failed $inc is logged, keeps the timer, the command still succeeds), one Enqueue of member_added per AddedBy doc then member_count_changed, Finish with the user count); RemoveMember/LeaveRoom/ChangeMemberRole/SetMemberPriority: validate (no self removal, valid target and role), admit (a tombstoned caller leaving again is a no-op, never a member = ErrNotMember), DM = ErrDirectRoom, one request id and time per command, ask the policy with caller, target doc or a stand-in role member target and role before any target verdict, missing = ErrMemberNotFound, tombstone = no-op for removal and ErrMemberNotFound for role/priority, same role/priority = no-op; ownership.Affects routes owner changes to Members.ChangeOwners with ownership.Plan as decide (policy re-asked on the docs read inside, successor written first, count from OwnerResult, no timer); the plain path arms the timer only when an active member leaves, writes one ApplyMember CAS on ver (miss = Disarm and ErrRetryLater at once, no retry loop), then the count as above; priority never goes through ownership; Limits.MemberBatch (0 = 500, 2..1000); Deps.Members/Requests/Forget/Timers required, Log and NewRequestID (17 random bytes hex) defaulted
tests: unit (miniredis request dedupe, fake timers, spy member store)

purpose: Reaction summary touch shared by the mutate fast path and the effect worker (D90): Count with witnesses (store.ErrStaleRead while a witness doc is behind), equal to the given summary -> no write and no version bump, else SetReactions CAS on rx.v (base 0 = missing) with version + 1; a lost CAS rereads the message (gone -> domain.ErrMessageNotFound) and recounts, up to the given tries, then ErrContended; store errors pass through

Pin projection shared by the mutate fast path and the effect worker (D92): Current = PinState + pin facts after its version folded with domain.FoldPins page by page (MaxPinScan), no write; Project(room, target) = read state, return it when already at target, fold, store.ErrStaleRead when the fold stays below target, ApplyPins CAS on pv (base 0 = missing), retry a lost CAS up to MaxTries then ErrContended; store errors wrapped with %w

Pure owner rules run inside store.ChangeOwners (D100), no I/O and no clock: Action (Leave, Remove, ChangeRole); Request carries caller, target, role, request id, time and the Allow policy closure; Affects is true for an active owner target or a change of role to owner (set priority never goes through it); Successor picks admin before member, then the highest Priority, then the earliest JoinedAt, then the smallest user id; Plan is the decide function: caller missing or left -> ErrNotMember (a leave by a tombstone is an empty plan), Allow asked with the real target when active else a stand-in with role member (no doc or tombstone, D101) before any target error, missing target -> ErrMemberNotFound, a left target is a no-op for leave/remove and ErrMemberNotFound for a role change, same role -> empty plan; Next keeps the priority; the last active owner stepping down -> ErrLastOwner, leaving or removed -> the successor is promoted to owner (keeping its priority) and written first, none -> only the target (empty group)
tests: unit;unit (memstore ChangeOwners: nested commits lose with ErrRetryLater, 24 rooms x 2 concurrent owner leaves never orphan a group)

purpose: Domain <-> protobuf mapping; RoomID as decimal string; MessageEventID {room}-{thread}-{seq}; RoomCreatedEventID {room}-created; MessageChangeEventID {room}-{thread}-{seq}-v{version}; Message carries version/deleted/edited_at (nil when zero)/hidden; MessageEdited/MessageDeleted envelopes (current snapshot + fact version; actor and ts from the fact); MessageVersions maps each edit row as is (EditOriginal -> EDIT_KIND_ORIGINAL at ver 0); MessageChanged picks msg_deleted for a delete fact (else msg_edited); Message carries reactions (ReactionSummary: nil when version 0 and no counts); ReactionEventID {room}-{thread}-{seq}-{user}-n{change}, ReactionCountsEventID {room}-{thread}-{seq}-reactions-v{version}, PinEventID {room}-p{pv} (table test: no two kinds share an id); ReactionChanged (actor = user), CountsChanged (counter reactions, no actor), MessagePinned/MessageUnpinned (snapshot + pin version; actor and ts from the fact); PinChanged picks by op and drops the text of a deleted target; Pins; member set events (D104): MemberEventID {room}-mb-{user}-v{ver}, MemberEvent picks one of member_added (with read_seq/read_ver; also docs created with the room)/member_removed (reason LEFT when updated_by is the user)/member_role_changed/member_priority_changed from the doc after the write, else nil (actor updated_by, ts updated_at, seq 0); MemberRole/DomainMemberRole (UNSPECIFIED -> InvalidArgument); MemberCountEventID {room}-members-v{ver} + MemberCountChanged (count clamped to int32, D102); ReadEventID {room}-rd-{user}-v{read_ver} + ReadUpdated (actor = reader, D105); HiddenEventID {room}-hd-{user}-{thread}-{seq} + MessageHidden, ClearedEventID {room}-cl-{user}-{cleared_at unix ms} + HistoryCleared (actor = user, D109)

JetStream publisher with only a queue per slot shard; each shard calls PublishMsgAsync in arrival order without waiting for acks; nats.go owns in-flight limit/ack timeout/no-leader retry; failures logged at most once per second; optional ack marks (WithAckMarks): after each PubAck the key is batched off the ack path into a Marker (a batch goes out at 256 keys or 10ms after its first key; close/abort flush the rest); Close waits for PublishAsyncComplete; Msg-Id = event id; Message builds the NATS msg (shared with reconcile); EnsureStream with one RePublish rule {root}.*.*.*.* -> {live}.{1}.{2}.{3}.evt.{4} (CreateOrUpdateStream rewrites an older rule) and a 5m duplicate window; subjectFor routes each kind to the subject of its data (D108): evt.{t}.room.{rid}.{kind} for room_created/msg_pinned/msg_unpinned/member_count_changed, evt.{t}.member.{rid}.{kind} for member_added/member_removed/member_role_changed/member_priority_changed/read_updated/message_hidden/history_cleared, evt.{t}.message.{rid}.{kind} for msg_created/msg_edited/msg_deleted/reaction_changed/counts_changed; an unknown kind is InvalidArgument and is not published; marks only events whose type has an ack mark policy (msg_created; the others have none); counts dropped events and failed marks
tests: unit;synctest;goleak;itest (Msg-Id dedupe; RePublish; async err handler; RePublish rule update to data subjects on real NATS)

purpose: Fake JetStream for tests with hold/refuse rules and PublishAsyncComplete

Reader of the commit log, runs only on the slot 0 owner: one term per lead opens store.ChangeFeed (logs reconcile term started); turns every MessageInserted/RoomInserted/EditInserted/ReactionChanged/PinInserted/MemberChanged/ReadChanged/MessageHidden/HistoryCleared change (work.KnownKind) into a key-only work record (work.RecordOf) published at once on its partition subject with Nats-Msg-Id = record id, on its own JetStream client; in-order window of RECONCILE_WINDOW with unbounded retry; confirms the position only past changes the work stream acked, every RECONCILE_CONFIRM_EVERY, never blocking longer without a checkpoint; corrupt or unknown-kind changes are dropped and confirmed past; history lost -> error log + Forget; exposes Stats (running, terms, forwarded, dropped, history lost)

Manual resync of a lost change feed range (/app resync): flags -from/-to (RFC3339), -tenant, -room, -rate (default 500/s, max 10000), -dry-run; walks rooms by store.ActiveRooms (activity bucket since -from or created in range, 500 per page) or one room; per room emits RoomInserted if created in range, MessageInserted for main-timeline messages created in range (backward Page scan, stops before -from), then by {r, ts} in range (one generic scanByTime: 1000 per page, paged by ts, the page edge deduped by record id; one instant filling a page is an error): EditInserted for message_edits facts (ErrEditPageFull), ReactionChanged for the current reactions docs including tombstones (Version = n, User; ErrReactionPageFull), PinInserted for pin_actions facts (Seq = pv; ErrPinPageFull); publishes work records synchronously at -rate; prints counts
tests: unit (memstore + fake publisher; synctest pacing);itest drill (apps/core)

Soft slot ownership on Redis: heartbeat Lua (SET chatim:core:{id} + ZADD chatim:cores by Redis TIME + prune); renew/claim/release leases chatim:slot:{n}; batched hooks with one HookTimeout per Step; Owns() cutoff

Storage ports Messages/Rooms; edit ports MessageEditor (ApplyEdit: CAS on the message version) and HistoryClearer (ClearHistory(at): $max cleared_at on an active member only, returns the mark after the write and whether it rose, sets last_change_at when it rises, zero time is invalid), Edits (Append insert-unique by room|thread|seq|version -> ErrEditExists; At -> ErrEditNotFound; Latest and History only rows ver >= 1, At reads ver 0 too; History after a version up to MaxEditPage; Between room + time range by ts then key up to MaxEditScan; PurgeText of rows 0..upTo), Hidden (Hide(at) upsert keeping the first hide time, HiddenIn ascending seqs, Between room + hide time range by time then user, thread, seq up to MaxHiddenScan); ValidateMarkTime; reaction ports Reactions (Set version-bump: write unless that emoji is already set, N + 1, Prev = old emoji; Remove leaves a tombstone and never inserts one; Get; Count of live docs per emoji, sorted, ErrStaleRead while a Witness doc is behind; Between room + time range by ts then key up to MaxReactionScan, tombstones included) and ReactionSummaries (SetReactions CAS on rx.v, base 0 = missing); pin ports Pins (Append insert-unique by room|pv -> ErrPinExists; At -> ErrPinNotFound; After ascending up to MaxPinScan; Between) and PinProjector (PinState: ErrRoomNotFound or empty; ApplyPins CAS on pv); ReactionKeyOf, ValidateReaction, ValidateReactionTarget, ValidatePinAction, ValidateVersionBump (next > base and <= MaxInt64); EditKeyOf, ValidateEdit (version 0..MaxInt32, ver 0 iff EditOriginal), ValidateProjectedEdit (no original row), ValidateLimit; and the database-neutral change feed port ChangeFeed/Cursor (Open, Forget, Next, Confirm, Close; sentinels ErrFeedHistoryLost/ErrFeedBusy/ErrCorruptChange; Change carries Kind MessageInserted with Msg, RoomInserted with Room, EditInserted with Edit, ReactionChanged with Reaction or PinInserted with Pin, MemberChanged (6) and HistoryCleared (9) with Member, ReadChanged (7) with Member room/user/read ver, MessageHidden (8) with Hidden, MemberCountCheck (10) never from the feed; kinds only grow at the end) and shared types: MsgKey; PageQuery anchors Latest/Oldest/Before/After; insert Outcome Inserted/Duplicate/Unknown/Rejected; key and room validation; room activity port TouchActivity ($max, never back; last seq and message time only for main-thread activity with seq > 0, so an edit activity with seq 0 bumps only the last change) and ActiveRooms (activity bucket since From or created in range, tenant, paged by id) with HourBucket; member set ports (member.go): MemberWriter (AddMembers version-bump: Join.Apply per user, active docs untouched, JoinResult docs after write in user order + Changed; ApplyMember CAS on ver, writes only membership fields), MemberReader (MembersOf any state in user order, 1..MaxMemberBatch+1 users;
